author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Remember when almost every Disney animated movie seemed to get its own TV show? From Aladdin and Timon & Pumbaa to The Emperor's New Groove and Big Hero 6, Disney once gave fans entire series of new adventures with their favorite characters. So what happened?

Why did Disney stop making so many of these shows? How did direct-to-video sequels change the company's priorities? And why are some of these forgotten Disney cartoons still missing from Disney+? The answer may be more complicated than it may seem...

Which forgotten Disney TV show do you remember watching? Let us know in the comments!

#disney #disneyanimation #disneyplus #nerdstalgic
title: Why Disney Buried ALL Of These Cartoons
